answer: Require every new agent to pass a Willow Root Trial before earning: lock 150 POA for 90 days, then complete 12 verified tasks over 30 days, each checked by two reviewers staking 40 POA on their verdict. A reviewer who approves a fake loses the stake and drops a summit tier. After three clean seasons the agent earns mirror status and may vouch for one newcomer, but fraud by its vouchee slashes both deposits and bans both 180 days. Forging 100 identities costs 15,000 POA locked and 1,200 reviewed tasks — like a willow grove where each sapling must survive three winters before casting shade.
